detail.bio: Alpindale is an AI researcher specializing in large language model development with expertise in model merging techniques, quantization optimization, and conversational AI systems. They have created numerous high-parameter models including Goliath-120B and Miquella-120B through sophisticated layer interleaving approaches. Their work spans multimodal vision-language models like Llama-3.2-90B-Vision-Instruct and efficient quantization implementations using EXL2 and VPTQ techniques. With contributions to organizations including Stanford AI, PygmalionAI, and DeepGHS, they focus on advancing text generation capabilities while optimizing model deployment through precision-reduced representations and memory-efficient architectures for practical applications.

Roger Condori (r3gm) is a prolific developer specializing in multimodal AI applications with extensive contributions to voice conversion, audio processing, and diffusion models. His work includes developing interactive spaces for real-time voice transformation using RVC technology, creating ControlNet models for Stable Diffusion XL with various conditioning techniques like QR codes, line art, and pose guidance, and building comprehensive audio processing pipelines for music source separation and video dubbing. He actively contributes to multiple AI communities including MusicAI, DeepGHS, and various open-source projects, focusing on making advanced AI technologies accessible through user-friendly interfaces and practical implementations. His portfolio demonstrates expertise in building end-to-end systems that bridge research with real-world applications across audio, image, and video modalities.
